description:
### Kaneki HUD

A dark, Tokyo Ghoul-inspired HUD for League of Legends, built around Kaneki Ken's aesthetic — centipede red, deep black, and that unraveling, kagune-tinged edge running through the UI.

**Base & credits**
Built on top of Disco's HUD as a base — full credit to him for the original work this skin was adapted from. Go check out his stuff too.

**Notes**
Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are always welcome. Hope you enjoy it!
